hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || { echo "statecat hook: could not cd to the project folder"; exit 0; }; if [ -f statecat.py ]; then S=; for P in python3 py python; do if $P -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))' 2>/dev/null; then S="$P statecat.py"; break; fi; done; [ -n "$S" ] || { echo "statecat hook: no Python 3.8+ found (tried python3, py, python)"; exit 0; }; else S=statecat; fi; $S show 2>&1 || echo "statecat hook: show failed (exit $?); STATE.md was not loaded"; $S check 2>&1 || echo "statecat hook: check failed or reported problems (exit $?)"; exit 0
